verdict.rationale: Better Stack sends push notifications and lets on-call engineers acknowledge many incidents 'with a single tap' to stop the phone ringing, plus press-1 acknowledgement on voice calls. That implies phone-based acknowledgement, but the evidence never names a dedicated mobile app. Resolving is only documented via Slack, not from a phone app. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a full mobile app, escalation and resolution from mobile, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the mobile experience.
